dial.summary: Real yields fell to 2.72% after Oct PCE came in softer, narrowing the headwind from restrictive monetary conditions while DXY eased to 103.83 on the first post-Thanksgiving trading day — BTC stabilizes near $59–60K with TOTAL at ~$2.09T after the holiday-week pullback, and perp funding at 0.0014% signals minimal leverage; the low-funding, elevated BTC.D structure (~57–59%) with macro on a softening trajectory supports continued BTC Accumulation ahead of the Dec 1 ISM print and the Dec 9 FOMC decision.

indicators.name: Global Liquidity (Global M2)
indicators.note: StreetStats 4-economy basket at $103.88T as of November 23, 2026 (most recent dated figure available); September 2026 G4 confirmed data is the base; US M2 component $23.41T in Sep (+5.7% YoY); 4-week trend UP; no YoY contraction signal; status supportive (4-week trend up); next G4 confirmation when October aggregates publish (US M2 next release December 22, 2026).

indicators.name: ISM Manufacturing PMI
indicators.note: October 2026 ISM Manufacturing PMI at 55.5% (released November 2, above consensus 54.6%), up from September's 54.5%; 4-week trend UP (Sep 54.5 → Oct 55.5, +1.0pp); Production sub-index 59.0 (highest since Nov 2021), New Orders 55.5; status supportive (above 50 and rising, 10th consecutive expansion month); November 2026 data not yet released — scheduled December 1, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET; MetaTrader consensus ~55.1.

indicators.name: DXY (US Dollar Index)
indicators.note: ICE DXY at 103.83 on November 26, 2026 (Trading Economics: 103.826, up 0.12% on the day; TMGM: near 103.85); DXY recovering from holiday-week low near 103.50 as dollar rebounds with AI trade; 4-week trend UP — from ~101.7 on October 23 to 103.83 on November 26, net +2.1 points (+2.1%), well above 0.5% flat threshold; status headwind (ICE DXY 103.83 is above 100 threshold).

indicators.name: Real Yields (US10Y - CPI)
indicators.note: 10-year TIPS real yield fell 7.74bps to 2.7226% at the November 25, 2026 New York close (Longbridge) after Oct PCE inflation data released — softer PCE drove a nominal Treasury rally; 4-week comparison: Oct 23 ~2.90% → Nov 25 ~2.72% = -18bps, exceeds 5bps flat threshold → trend DOWN; status supportive (falling trend, per scoring rules); prior run on Nov 25 cited 2.79% based on Nov 24 close before the PCE-driven move.

indicators.name: 2s10s Yield Curve
indicators.note: 2s10s spread ~24bps as of November 25, 2026 close (2yr 4.61%, 10yr 4.85% per daily wrap; Stockmarketwatch Nov 24: 28bps; Nov 20 official Treasury par curve: 29bps); post-PCE front-end rally compressed the spread from prior +25bps; 4-week comparison: Oct 23 ~+40bps → Nov 26 ~+24bps = flattened ~16bps → trend DOWN (flattening); curve remains positive, well above -50bps headwind threshold; status neutral.

indicators.name: Fed Balance Sheet
indicators.note: WALCL at $6,741,452M ($6.74T) as of November 18, 2026 per Federal Reserve H.4.1 (Nov 11: $6,758,867M; Oct 21: $6,753,604M); 4-week comparison: Oct 21 $6,753,604M → Nov 18 $6,741,452M = -$12.2B = -0.18%, within flat threshold; next H.4.1 release November 27, 2026 (covering Nov 25 Wednesday balance); status supportive (QT effectively paused, balance sheet stable); composition: Treasuries ~$4,587B, MBS ~$1,884B (Nov 11).

indicators.name: BTC Funding Rates (perps avg)
indicators.note: BTC perpetual funding rate at ~0.0014% per 8h as of November 26, 2026 (Coinbase perp: 0.0014% with BTC ~$60,840; CoinPerps OI-weighted: +0.0029% as of Nov 17 close); rates stepped down from prior run's 0.0024% as BTC price consolidated in the $59–60K range; 30-day trend FLAT (consistently below 0.01%, near-zero throughout); status supportive (0.0014% far below 0.04% headwind threshold).

indicators.name: Stablecoin Dominance
indicators.note: Total crypto market cap ~$2.09T on November 26, 2026 (CoinMarketCap: $2.08T, CoinGecko: $2.09T; BTC dominance 56–59% across sources; BTC ~$58,651–$60,609); stablecoin market cap ~$289B (CoinGecko); derived dominance ~13.8% ($289B/$2.09T); 30-day trend UP — from ~10.7% on October 23 (total market ~$2.6T) to ~13.8% now; status neutral (stablecoin dominance rising on 30-day basis but total market cap declined from ~$2.6T → ~$2.09T — headwind requires BOTH rising simultaneously, not met); TOTAL stabilizing after post-Thanksgiving dip.

upcoming.title: ISM Manufacturing PMI (November 2026)
upcoming.note: ISM releases November 2026 Manufacturing PMI at 10:00 AM ET (first business day of December); October reading was 55.5 (10th consecutive expansion month, above consensus 54.6%); consensus for November is ~55.1; a continuation above 55 reinforces the late-cycle expansion narrative heading into the December 9 FOMC meeting; Prices Paid sub-index closely watched given elevated input cost pressures in October.

upcoming.title: JOLTS Job Openings (October 2026)
upcoming.note: BLS releases October 2026 JOLTS at 10:00 AM ET; a print above 8M openings would reinforce the tight labor market narrative supporting the December 9 rate decision; the quits rate is a leading indicator of wage growth; released 3 days before the November NFP (December 4).

upcoming.title: ADP Private Employment (November 2026)
upcoming.note: ADP releases November 2026 National Employment Report at 8:15 AM ET; private sector payroll estimate published 2 days before the official BLS NFP (December 4); a print above 200K would align with the strong labor market narrative ahead of the December 9 FOMC decision.

upcoming.title: ISM Services PMI (November 2026)
upcoming.note: ISM releases November 2026 Non-Manufacturing (Services) PMI at 10:00 AM ET; services sector activity closely watched given the Fed's focus on services inflation; a reading above 55 would reinforce the tight labor/services backdrop heading into the December 9 FOMC meeting; released one day before November NFP.
